zeroDuplicateBookings.query: SELECT requirement_id, worker_id, count(*) FROM booking GROUP BY requirement_id, worker_id HAVING count(*) > 1;

zeroOverfilledRequirements.query: SELECT id, worker_count_needed, worker_count_filled FROM job_requirement WHERE worker_count_filled > worker_count_needed;

orphanedBookings.query: SELECT count(*) FROM booking b LEFT JOIN job_requirement r ON b.requirement_id = r.id WHERE r.id IS NULL;

postgisSpatialIntegrity.query: SELECT count(*) FROM worker WHERE location_geo IS NOT NULL AND ST_IsValid(location_geo::geometry) = false;
